scripts.build: cd backend && pnpm build && cd ../frontend && pnpm build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e:typecheck && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:system: browser=$(command -v chromium-browser || command -v chromium) || { printf '%s\n' 'Chromium not found: install chromium-browser or chromium on PATH.' >&2; exit 1; }; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 E2E_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH="$browser" E2E_BROWSER_ARGS='["--no-sandbox","--disable-dev-shm-usage"]' pnpm test:e2e
